map.脱模剂进场自检：按脱模力、残留量、环保达标率三项判定: Release-agent incoming self-check: judge by release force, residue and environmental compliance
map.制品质量：残留量影响后处理与外观: Product quality: residue affects post-processing and appearance
map.逐项判定：脱模力≤50N、残留量≤10mg/dm²、环保达标率≥90%；三项均满: Item-by-item: release force ≤50 N, residue ≤10 mg/dm², environmental ≥90%; all pass → qualified. Low release force eases demoulding; low residue helps downstream steps.
map.脱模力 35N（≤50 ✓）、残留 5mg/dm²（≤10 ✓）、环保 95%（: Release force 35 N (≤50 ✓), residue 5 mg/dm² (≤10 ✓), environmental 95% (≥90 ✓): all pass → qualified. If residue rises to 15 mg/dm² it fails, hurting bonding/coating.
map.残留多会污染制品表面、影响后续粘接/喷涂，甚至引入异物；≤10mg/dm² 为常: Excess residue pollutes the surface, hurts later bonding/spraying and may introduce foreign matter; ≤10 mg/dm² is a common pass cap, stricter for food/medical grades.
map.脱模力越小越好？: Is smaller release force always better?
map.过小可能脱模不牢或塌模，须在易脱模与成型稳定间平衡；≤50N 为示例上限，具体按: Too small may demould poorly or collapse the mould; balance easy release with forming stability; ≤50 N is an example cap, set by part and process.

map.残留物检测需对模具表面进行萃取分析: Residue testing needs extraction analysis of the mould surface
